repositories.description: Windows Kernel Filter Driver for keyboard, mouse and USB gamepad input interception/remapping. DS4/DualShock 4 (PS4), DualSense (PS5), wired Xbox 360 and Xbox One/Series X|S via compatible HID/XInput/GIP profiles. Microsoft-signed demo, C++17 SDK, GUI/CLI installers.
Windows Kernel Filter Driver for keyboard and mouse input interception, remapping and blocking. Microsoft-signed Windows 10/11 x64 demo, simple C++17 SDK, GUI/CLI installers and console/UI examples.

Windows Kernel Filter Driver for gamepad/controller input interception and remapping. HID, XInput/XUSB, XInputHID and GIP; DS4/PS4, DualSense/PS5, wired Xbox 360 and Xbox One/Series profiles. Microsoft-signed one-hour-per-kernel-boot demo, C++17 SDK, GUI/CLI installers.
Windows kernel driver for virtual USB keyboard, mouse and gamepad devices. Raw C++ SDK; Xbox 360/XInput, DS4 and Xbox One/GIP examples. Microsoft-signed one-hour-per-kernel-boot demo.
Microsoft-signed Windows keyboard and mouse kernel driver with the original Interception C SDK, legacy application compatibility, and a one-hour demo.
The Interception API aims to build a portable programming interface that allows one to intercept and control a range of input devices.
Windows kernel-mode driver emulating well-known USB game controllers.
ViGEm Client SDK for feeder development.
Gaming Input Peripherals Device Firewall for Windows.
This repo contains driver samples prepared for use with Microsoft Visual Studio and the Windows Driver Kit (WDK). It contains both Universal Windows Driver and desktop-only driver samples.
